requirements.1_project_inventory_and_ownership: Canonical existing public repository/admin and authenticated Kaggle owner inspected; clean baseline and current refs checked; one first-party manuscript plus generated figures and historical builds identified.
requirements.2_manuscript_disclosure: Exact sentence in authoritative TeX, compiled/distributed PDF, both source ZIPs, README, dataset card and notebook; broader disclosure retained; human attribution unchanged.
requirements.3_public_exposure_and_rights: Prior reachable-history/surfaces/rights audit remains bound to unchanged baseline; current deltas and decoded package members pass credential-value and archive guards; no license or restricted-input expansion.
requirements.4_coherent_release_and_execution: Stable 13-page build/render inspection; seven saved-output verifiers/20 claim groups; 89 tests/39 subtests; four-cell fresh local notebook and CLI PASS/FAIL smoke; no native experiments newly claimed.
requirements.5_github_publication: Normal atomic branch/tag push; v0.1.1 immutable source commit; published Release; 15 source/data assets plus 9 proof assets downloaded anonymously and hash matched; prior tag/release preserved.
requirements.6_kaggle_publication: Existing public dataset v3 provides manuscript and full source supplement (1780 expanded files); notebook v4 provides substantive narrative and four executable code cells. No standalone writeup option in inspected Create menu.
requirements.7_live_verification: Computer-use inspection of authenticated GitHub settings/release, Kaggle versions/input pinning/CPU/offline settings, fresh successful 62.8s viewer; anonymous exact-version downloads/source/output verifiers; actual public PDF renders as inspected.
requirements.8_honest_report_and_deliverables: Publication receipt records actual URLs/tag/commit/versions, exact disclosure, reruns versus prior native outcomes, PUBLISHED AND VERIFIED/NOT APPLICABLE classifications, exclusions and access limitations; no blockers or user actions.

limits: Kaggle inline PDF preview is unavailable; anonymous dataset download supplies the verified PDF.
Anonymous Kaggle session-status endpoint requires authentication; execution success/runtime observed in UI, source and eight outputs downloaded independently.
Saved-trace reanalysis does not repeat native framework acquisition or establish execution attestation, peer review, detector superiority, learned-policy performance or hardware safety.
Original TeX style files retain distinct terms and exact acquisition instructions; ZIP snapshots omit them and Git ancestry, while the full public clone retains original committed gates.
post_tag_changes: Only current documentation and post-publication proof records; tagged code/data/PDF and all 406 frozen files unchanged.
